title: Enact the Joining-Opportunities Business and Schools (JOBS) Act
subject: Economic Development
Education
Higher Education
Taxation

abstracts.abstract: To amend section 5751.98 and to enact sections 3333.46 and 5751.55 of the Revised Code to enact the Joining-Opportunities Business and Schools (JOBS) Act to authorize and offer tax incentives for qualified education partnerships between institutions of higher education and private employers.
